business.name: Holiday Inn Express New - Orleans Downtown

ranking.name: Holiday Inn Express New - Orleans Downtown

text.text_excerpt: We stayed in the executive sweet which was roomy. This place has been updated and is conveniently located to public transport, restaurants,train station, and Dave and Busters. The pool is small but plenty big enough for the kids. One side is 3.5 ft and the other is 5.5ft. The steps are covered in small concrete bumps that are tough in little ones skin. They do offer a free continental breakfast from 6:30-9:30am. Which is why I chose this one over the other Holiday inn. This trip our family slept late and arrived at breakfast around 8. There was not a lot left and not sure what was there before. No bagels, muffins, toast, fruit available. They did have cereal, pre-made omelets, milk, boile...

I don't understand the bad reviews here. Easy check in. Clean, mostly quiet room with friendly staff. We've stayed at many Holiday Inn Express and know what to expect. I like to not have to figure out breakfast. Unfortunately breakfast here wasn't that good. We've had better. There were a couple little things too, like there was no bath mat until our last day. There was no "I'm busy" hangtag for the door. I did appreciate the fresh water bottles left 3 out of our 5 days. Easy check out. They stored our luggage until our flight, called us a taxi and mailed(hopefully) my postcards.

Convenient location to stay at! Close to the trolley cars, Bourbon Street, & Frenchmen Street. All the workers were friendly, helpful, & made me feel welcomed. The assistant general manager took time to introduce himself, informed us about local attractions, & to let him know if any issues were encountered with the hotel. My flight arrived early. The front desk let me check into my hotel room early. I ended up having a late flight out of New Orleans. The front desk let me have a late check-out, & they also let me keep my bags at the hotel, after checkout. Therefore, I could pick them up right before my departing flight. The rooms were smaller than most IHG hotels that I've stayed at. Howe...
